issues.detail: The Hebrew text states that Cyrus the king issued a decree (שָׂם טְעֵם) to rebuild this house of God, but the Chinese adds '准許' (permitted/allowed), which is an addition not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew simply says he 'issued a decree' to rebuild, not that he 'permitted' it. This addition changes the nuance from a direct command/decree to a permission.
